blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: This report summarizes the Mobile Unified Multimodal Understanding (MUMU) track of the 8th Large-scale Video Object Segmentation (LSVOS) Challenge, held in conjunction with ECCV 2026. MUMU asks for a single unified model that jointly performs multi-concept image tagging over quality, scene, and event vocabularies, open-vocabulary object detection, and concise image captioning, within a budget of 0.5B parameters and 8 GB of peak inference memory. Submissions are ranked by a weighted task score scaled by an efficiency factor. We describe the tasks, rules, and evaluation protocol, report the final results, and review the methods of the top three teams. All three leading solutions build on the compact Florence-2-base model, but extend it in different ways: lightweight tagging heads with cross-task inference refinement, a shared low-rank adapter trained on coverage-aware multi-source data with task-dependent decoding, and a training-free pipeline that maps captions to tags and applies detection test-time augmentation. The results show that a compact prompt-based vision-language model can serve all three outputs when supervision, decoding, and cross-task cues are designed for each task, while open-vocabulary detection on novel categories remains the main bottleneck.
blocks.zh: 本报告概述了第8大视频对象分区移动统一多式联运轨道 挑战,与ECCV 2026同时举行. MUMU要求在0.5B参数和8GB峰值推论内存的预算范围内,建立一个单一的统一模型,在质量、场景和事件词汇上联合进行多概念图像标记,开放的vocabulary对象检测和简洁的图像字幕。 提交材料按效率系数加权任务分数排序。 我们描述各项任务、规则和评价规程,报告最终结果,并审查前三个小组的方法。 所有三种领先的解决方案都以紧凑的Florence-2-base模型为基础,但以不同的方式加以扩展:轻量级标记头与跨任务推论的改进,一个共享的低级适配器以任务依赖的解码对覆盖-知觉多源数据进行培训,以及一个无培训的管道,将标题映射到标记,并应用检测测试时间的增强. 结果显示,当为每项任务设计监督、解码和跨任务提示时,一个紧凑的即时视觉语言模型可以服务于所有三种产出,而新分类的开放式伏车检测仍然是主要的瓶颈。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Visual understanding on mobile and other resource-constrained devices rarely reduces to a single task. A practical system may need to describe the global content and quality of an image, localize the objects it contains, and summarize the scene in natural language. Maintaining a dedicated model for each capability multiplies parameters, memory, and maintenance cost, and prevents the models from using each other’s predictions. Unified vision–language models address this by casting heterogeneous tasks as conditional sequence generation over a shared representation [ 3 , 27 , 23 , 28 ] . Many recent multimodal models, however, couple image encoders with billion-parameter language models [ 21 ] , far beyond what can be deployed on a mobile budget.
blocks.zh: 对移动设备和其他受资源限制设备的可视理解很少降低为单一任务. 一个实用的系统可能需要描述一个图像的全球内容和质量,将其包含的物体本地化,并用自然语言来总结场景. 为每种能力维持一个专门的模型,将参数、内存和维护成本相乘,并阻止模型相互利用各自的预测。 统一愿景-语言模型通过将不同的任务设定为有条件的序列生成,而不是共享代表[3、27、23、28]来解决这一问题。 然而,许多最近的多模式模式,配有十亿参数语言模式的组合图像编码器[21],远远超出了可部署在移动预算上的程度。

blocks.en: The Mobile Unified Multimodal Understanding (MUMU) track studies this problem directly [ 20 ] . Participants must design a single unified model that simultaneously performs multi-concept image tagging, open-vocabulary object detection, and image captioning under a constrained computational budget. Independent task-specific models are not permitted; adapters and low-rank modules are allowed only inside the unified architecture. The challenge emphasizes algorithmic efficiency, architectural unification, and deployability, and measures complexity with PC-side compute statistics instead of on-device execution.
blocks.zh: 移动统一多式联运谅解(MUMU)跟踪直接研究这一问题[20]。 参与者必须设计一个单一的统一模型,在有限的计算预算下同时进行多概念的图像标记、开放式的活字标出和图像字幕。 独立的任务特定模式是不允许的;适配器和低等模块只能在统一架构内允许. 这一挑战强调算法效率、建筑统一和可部署性,并用PC-侧计算统计数据衡量复杂性,而不是在设备上执行。

blocks.en: The three outputs place different demands on a shared model. Tagging predicts closed-vocabulary label sets in which rare quality, scene, and event concepts all count equally under macro-averaging. Detection predicts a variable-size set of labeled boxes and must generalize to categories hidden from participants. Captioning must produce a fluent, image-grounded English sentence under a strict length limit. A compact model must therefore balance supervision, decoding, and post-processing across tasks whose errors have different costs, and no off-the-shelf compact model natively covers all three.
blocks.zh: 三项产出对共同模式提出了不同的要求。 Tagging预言闭合-vocabulary标签集,其中稀有的质量,场景,事件概念都在宏渲染下平等计数. 检测预测一组可变大小的被标记的框,必须被概括为隐藏在参与者身上的类别. Captioning必须在严格的长度限制下产生流利,以图像为基础的英语句子. 因此,一个紧凑的模型必须平衡监督、解码和处理后的各种任务,这些任务的错误具有不同的成本,没有现成的紧凑模型本身就涵盖所有三项。

blocks.en: MUMU is held as an additional track of the 8th LSVOS Challenge in conjunction with ECCV 2026 in Malmö, Sweden [ 19 ] . Alongside it, the three main tracks of the challenge address complex video object segmentation on MOSEv2 and text- and audio-guided referring video object segmentation on MeViSv2 [ 8 , 11 , 7 , 9 , 22 , 10 , 6 ] . While these tracks focus on dense spatio-temporal grounding, MUMU complements them with efficient image-level multimodal understanding.
blocks.zh: MUMU作为第8届LSVOS挑战赛的附加赛,与ECCV 2026一起在瑞典马尔默举行 [19]. 除此以外,挑战的三个主要轨道涉及MOSEv2上的复杂的视频物体分化,以及MeViSv2上的文本和音频导引视频物体分化[8、11、7、9、22、10、6]。 虽然这些轨道侧重于密集的斯皮提奥-时空地面,但MUMU以高效的图像层面多模式理解来补充这些轨道。

blocks.en: In this report, we describe the MUMU tasks, rules, and evaluation protocol, present the official results, and summarize the solutions of the top three teams from their technical reports. We then compare their recurring design choices, including the shared backbone, how tagging is added to a prompt-based model, cross-task reuse of predictions, and task-specific decoding, and discuss open directions.
blocks.zh: 在本报告中,我们介绍MUMU的任务、规则和评价协议,介绍官方结果,并从其技术报告中总结前三个小组的解决办法。 然后,我们比较他们反复出现的设计选择,包括共享主干,标记如何被添加到一个即时模型中,跨任务再利用预测,以及任务特定的解码,并讨论开放方向.

blocks.en: 2 The MUMU Track
blocks.zh: 2 MUMU轨道

blocks.en: 2.1 Tasks
blocks.zh: 2.1 任务

blocks.en: For every test image, a submission must return the outputs of three tasks, all produced by the same unified model through a single inference call.
blocks.zh: 对于每一个测试图像,一个提交必须返回三个任务的输出,所有输出都是由同一个统一模型通过单一的推论调取而来.

blocks.en:
Task A: Multi-Concept Image Tagging. The model predicts semantic concept labels in three namespaces: image quality attributes ( e.g . , blur, noise, exposure, and compression artifacts), scene categories ( e.g . , indoor, office, kitchen, street, and stadium), and event categories ( e.g . , concert, wedding, sports event, protest, and festival). Labels must be drawn from the published closed vocabulary, which contains 10 quality, 35 scene, and 18 event labels.
Each namespace is a multi-label prediction, and empty lists are allowed.
blocks.zh:
任务A:多概念 图像标签。 该模型在三个取名空间中预测了语义概念标签:图像质量属性(如:模糊,噪声,曝光和压缩等文物),场景类别(如:室内,办公室,厨房,街道和体育场),以及活动类别(如:音乐会,婚礼,体育活动,抗议和节日等). 标签必须取自已出版的封闭词汇,其中包含10个质量,35个场景,18个事件标签.
每个命名空间都是多标签预测,允许空列表.

blocks.en: Task B: Open-Vocabulary Object Detection. The model detects objects and returns, for each detection, a free-form lowercase text label, a confidence score in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , and a bounding box in absolute pixel coordinates of the original image. At most 300 detections are accepted per image. Novel detection categories are hidden in the final evaluation, so the model must generalize beyond the categories seen during training.
blocks.zh: 任务 B: 开放词汇 物体探测 该模型检测对象并返回,对于每次检测,一个自由形式的小写文字标签,在 [0, 1] [0, 1] 中的置信分数,以及原始图像的绝对像素坐标中的边框. 每个图像最多接受300次检测。 小说检测类别被隐藏在最终评价中,因此模型必须被概括到培训期间看到的类别之外.

blocks.en: Task C: Efficient Image Captioning. The model generates a concise, single-line English description of each image. A caption must be non-empty and contain at most 300 characters and at most 30 evaluator tokens, where tokens are counted after Unicode normalization and lowercasing.
blocks.zh: 任务C:高效图像说明. 该模型生成每个图像的简洁而单行的英文描述. 标题必须是非空的,并包含最多300个字符和最多30个评估标志,其中的标志在Unicode正常化和下架后计算。

blocks.en: 2.2 Datasets
blocks.zh: 2.2 数据集

blocks.en: Participants are encouraged to train on the public datasets listed in Table 1 , which together cover the three tasks. Because most sources annotate only one namespace or task, constructing a training mixture with adequate label coverage is itself part of the challenge. Final rankings are computed on a held-out test set of 1,038 images whose annotations are not released.
blocks.zh: 鼓励与会者接受表1所列公共数据集的培训,这些数据集共同涵盖三项任务。 由于大多数来源只标注了一个命名空间或任务,构建一个具有适当标签覆盖的训练混合物本身就是挑战的一部分. 最终排名是根据一套不公布说明的1 038个图像进行的。

blocks.en: Table 1 : Recommended training datasets of the MUMU track.
blocks.zh: 表1: MUMU轨道建议的培训数据集。

blocks.en: 2.3 Rules and Resource Constraints
blocks.zh: 2.3 规则和资源制约

blocks.en: Each submission must use a single unified model. Adapters and LoRA modules are allowed within this architecture, but independent task-specific models are not, and all task heads must be integrated into the unified model. The model may contain at most 0.5B parameters and use at most 8 GB of peak inference memory, measured on the PC side. Submissions declare their parameter count, GFLOPs for one forward pass at 224 × 224 224\times 224 resolution, and peak inference memory; declared values above the limits are rejected automatically. Each team also submits model weights and an inference script that returns tags, detections, and a caption from a single call. Top-ranked entries are reproduced by the organizers and disqualified if their results cannot be reproduced, if they use independent task-specific models, or if they exceed any resource constraint. The organizers provide a baseline built on the pretrained Florence-2-base model [ 28 ] and Microsoft’s public Florence-2 fine-tuning toolkit.
blocks.zh: 每一份划界案必须使用单一的统一模式。 适配器和LORA模块在此架构内是允许的,但独立的任务特定模式却不许可,所有任务负责人都必须被整合入统一模式. 该模型最多可能包含0.5B参数,并最多使用8GB的峰值推断内存,在PC侧被测量. 提交声明其参数计数,GFLOP一个前行通过224×224/224\times 224分辨率,并峰值推算内存;超过极限的已声明值被自动拒绝. 每个团队还提交模型加权和回放标记,检测的推想脚本,以及单调的字幕. 排名最高的条目由组织者复制,如果其结果无法复制,如果使用独立的任务特定模式,或者超过任何资源约束,则取消资格. 主办方提供基于预训的佛罗伦萨-2-基模型[28]和微软的公用佛罗伦萨-2微调工具包的基线.

blocks.en: 2.4 Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 2.4 评价议定书

blocks.en: Task A is evaluated by macro-F1 over the tag vocabulary, Task B by novel-aware mAP over IoU thresholds from 0.50 to 0.95, and Task C by a combination of CIDEr-D [ 26 ] , SPICE [ 1 ] , and CLIPScore [ 15 ] : C = 0.4 ​ CIDEr + 0.3 ​ SPICE + 0.3 ​ CLIPScore . C=0.4\,\mathrm{CIDEr}+0.3\,\mathrm{SPICE}+0.3\,\mathrm{CLIPScore}. (1) The three task scores, denoted A A , B B , and C C , are combined into a weighted performance term S S , which is scaled by an efficiency factor E E determined by model complexity: S = 0.3 ​ A + 0.4 ​ B + 0.3 ​ C , Final = S × E . S=0.3A+0.4B+0.3C,\qquad\mathrm{Final}=S\times E. (2) Ties are broken by lower peak inference memory, then by lower parameter count, and finally by higher detection performance.
blocks.zh: 任务 A由宏-F1在标记词汇上评价,任务B由小说意识的mAP在IoU阈值上评价从0.50到0.95,任务C由CIDER-D [26],SPICE [1]和CLIPScore [15]:C=0.4 CIDER + 0.3 SPICE + 0.3 CLIPScore. C=0.4\,\mathrm{CIDER}+0.3\,\mathrm{SPICE}+0.3\,\mathrm{CLIPScore}组合. (1)三个任务分数,即A,B,C三个分数合并成加权性能名词"S S",由由模型复杂度决定的效率因子"E"来缩放:S=0.3 A+0.4 B+0.3 C,最终=S× E. S=0.3A+0.4B+0.3C,\quad\mathrm{Final_S\times E. (2) 铁丝网被下峰推算内存所打破,再由下参数计数所打破,最后通过更高的检测性能被打破.

blocks.en: 2.5 Challenge Results
blocks.zh: 2.5 挑战结果

blocks.en: Table 2 reports the final leaderboard. SSUfficient wins the track with a Final score of 17.34, followed by Team Spicy Gradient Descent with 16.72 and DDUN with 16.48. All three entries improve over the Florence-2-base baseline. The winning entry obtains the best detection and captioning scores, whereas Team Spicy Gradient Descent achieves the best tagging score, more than 11 points above the other two entries. Team Spicy Gradient Descent fine-tunes the shared model for all three tasks and obtains a lower caption score than the baseline. The first- and third-place entries keep the pretrained captioning pathway frozen and obtain the two highest caption scores. Detection scores remain low for every team, between 4.36 and 8.22, reflecting the difficulty of generalizing to hidden novel categories.
blocks.zh: 表2报告最终领导板. SSUfficent以17.34分的终局分数取胜于赛道,而后以16.72分以16.48分的成绩取胜于Team Spicy Gradient Empire. 所有三个条目都比佛罗伦萨-2基数基线有所改善. 取胜的入球获得最佳的检测和字幕分数,而Team Spicy Gradient Eduent则获得最佳的标记分数,比其他两个入球多出11分. Team Spicy Gradient Edentein对所有三项任务的共享模式进行微调并获得比基线更低的字幕分数. 第一和第三位置的条目保留了预训字幕路径被冻结并获得两个最高字幕分数. 每支球队的侦测分数仍然很低,在4.36到8.22之间,反映了被概括到隐藏的小说类别上的难度.

blocks.en: Table 3 summarizes model complexity. All three teams build on Florence-2-base, so their models contain between 231M and 240M parameters, less than half of the 0.5B limit, and their efficiency factors are close. Peak inference memory ranges from about 0.6 GB to 7.5 GB, below the 8 GB limit in all cases.
blocks.zh: 表3总结了模型的复杂性。 三支球队都以Florence-2-base为基础,因此其型号包含231M到240M参数,还不到0.5B极限的一半,其效率因素相近. 峰值推想内存从0.6GB到7.5GB左右,在所有情况下均低于8GB的限制.

blocks.en: 3 Top Solutions in the MUMU Track
blocks.zh: MUMU 轨道中的顶端解决方案

blocks.en: 3.1 1st Place: SSUfficient
blocks.zh: 3.1 第1个地点: SSUfficient

blocks.en: Method EUMU: Efficient Unified Multimodal Understanding Authors Dayoung Kil 1 , Seong-heum Kim 1 Affiliations 1 Department of Intelligent Semiconductors, Soongsil University, Seoul, Republic of Korea
blocks.zh: Method EUMU: 高效统一多模式理解作者 Dayoung Kil 1, Seong-heum Kim 1 附属机构 1 智能半导体系,大韩民国首尔,Soongsil大学

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Overview of EUMU (SSUfficient). One Florence-2-base model is shared across tasks; lightweight heads predict tags from shared visual features, and task outputs are reused as cross-task cues for inference refinement.
blocks.zh: 图1:欧盟货币联盟概览(SSUfficient)。 一个佛罗伦萨-2基模型是跨任务共享的;轻量级头从共享的视觉特性中预测出标记,任务输出被再用作为跨任务提示来进行推论完善.

blocks.en: EUMU shares a single frozen Florence-2-base model [ 28 ] across tagging, detection, and captioning. As shown in Fig. 1 , the input image is encoded once by the image encoder and transformer encoder into a shared visual representation. Detection and captioning use task prompts and the pretrained decoder without fine-tuning, while three lightweight tagging heads operate directly on the shared visual features. Instead of running the tasks independently, EUMU applies task-aware inference refinement in a directed sequence: it first obtains initial tags, base detections, and a context caption; the caption then expands the detection candidates; the final detections refine the caption; and lastly, image statistics, the final caption, and the final detections refine the tags.
blocks.zh: EUMU共享一个单一被冻结的佛罗伦萨-2-基模 [28] 跨越标记,检测和字幕. 如图一所示,输入图像被一次被图像编码器和变压器编码为共享的视觉表现. 检测和字幕使用任务提示和未进行微调的预训解码器,而三个轻量级标记头直接在共享的视觉特性上操作. EUMU不独立地运行这些任务,而是在定向的序列中应用任务感知推论的改进:它首先获得初始标记,基础检测,以及上下文标题;然后标题扩展检测对象;最终检测精炼了标题;最后,图像统计,最终标题,最后检测精炼了标记.

blocks.en: Florence-2 offers no native prompt for multi-concept tagging. EUMU therefore adds three MLP heads for quality, scene, and event prediction on top of the shared visual features. Each head produces label-wise scores from which the initial tags are obtained. Because tagging bypasses the transformer decoder, all three tag types are predicted without modifying the pretrained multimodal model. The heads are trained on the official MUMU training data, supplemented with samples constructed from the same split to address sparse quality and event labels: synthetic degradations such as blur, noise, low light, and overexposure provide additional quality examples, and event-related cues extracted from training captions provide additional event labels.
blocks.zh: 佛罗伦萨2号没有为多概念标记提供本土的提示. 因此,EUMU在共享的视觉特征上增加了3个MLP头,用于质量,场景和事件预测. 每个头都产生出有标签的分数,从中获得初始标记. 因为标记绕过变压器解码器,所以所有三种标记类型都是在不修改预先训练的多式模型的情况下预测的. 头部接受关于MUMU正式培训数据的培训,并辅以从同一分块中构建的样本,以解决质量和事件标签稀薄的问题:诸如模糊、噪音、低光等合成降解和过度曝光提供了更多的质量实例,从培训标题中提取的事件相关提示提供了额外的事件标签。

blocks.en: EUMU first runs base object detection with the <OD> prompt to obtain boxes and labels. To recover objects missed at this stage, it extracts object and phrase cues from the context caption. These cues drive two further passes of the same model: open-vocabulary detection ( <OPEN_VOCABULARY_DETECTION> ) detects additional objects named in the caption, and phrase grounding ( <CAPTION_TO_PHRASE_GROUNDING> ) localizes caption phrases. Candidates from the three stages are merged, labels are normalized to the evaluation vocabulary, invalid boxes are removed, and non-maximum suppression (NMS) suppresses duplicates. The remaining boxes, labels, and confidence scores form the final detections.
blocks.zh: EUMU首先以"OD"("OD")来运行底物检测,以获取盒子和标签. 为了恢复此阶段丢失的对象, 它从上下文标题中提取对象和短语提示 。 这些提示驱动了同一型号的另外两段路由: 开放-vocabulary reference("OPEN_VOCABULARY_DETECTION") 探测到标题中命名的其他对象,而词组起落("CAPTION_TO_PHRASE_GROUNDING") 本地化了标题词组. 三个阶段的候选人被合并,标签与评价词汇正常化,无效框被去掉,非最大压制(NMS)压制重复. 其余的盒子,标签,和信心分数构成最终检测.

blocks.en: The context caption is generated with the <MORE_DETAILED_CAPTION> prompt. After the final detections are available, EUMU compares the detected object labels with the words in the caption and uses their overlap as an additional cue to refine it, so that the caption better reflects the detected objects. The refined caption is then post-processed to satisfy the length limits while preserving sentence completeness: overly long outputs are truncated, incomplete sentence endings caused by truncation are removed, redundant whitespace and line breaks are deleted, and sentence-ending punctuation is added when needed.
blocks.zh: 上下文标题由 < MORE_DETAILED_CAPTION> 提示生成。 在最终检测可用后,EUMU将检测到的对象标签与标题中的单词进行比较,并用其重叠作为额外的提示来完善,使标题更好地反映被检测对象. 然后经过后处理,以满足长度限制,同时保留句子完整性:过度长的输出被截断,由截断导致的句子结尾被去掉,冗余的白空和换行被删除,需要时会添加句子终止的平分.

blocks.en: Each label group is refined with the cues most relevant to it. Quality labels are tied to low-level image characteristics, so the head scores are complemented by image statistics such as brightness distribution, contrast, gradient, noise, and compression artifacts; for example, brightness statistics refine low-light, underexposure, and overexposure predictions. Scene predictions are refined with location cues from the final caption together with the detected objects, which allows a generic prediction such as outdoor to be replaced by a more specific scene category. Event predictions combine action cues from the caption with object cues from the detections, such as a stage and a microphone for a performance or a race number and a finish line for a sports event. Event predictions inconsistent with the caption, scene tags, and detections are removed.
blocks.zh: 每个标签组都用与之最相关的提示来完善. 质量标签与低等图像特征相挂钩,因此头分数被图像统计所补充,如亮度分布,对比度,梯度,噪声等压缩文物等;例如亮度统计精炼出低等亮度,曝光度不足,以及曝光度过高的预测. 场景预测用从最终标题中取出的位置提示和被检测出的对象来细化,这样可以将室外等通用预测被更具体的场景类别所取代. 事件预测将字幕中的动作提示与检测中的对象提示相结合,例如表演或比赛号的舞台和麦克风以及体育活动的终点. 与标题、场景标记和检测不一致的事件预测被删除。

blocks.en: 3.2 2nd Place: Team Spicy Gradient Descent

As shown in Fig. 2 , the submitted model combines coverage-aware multi-source supervision with task-dependent decoding. For an image x x , one call of the predictor returns F θ ​ ( x ) = ( T ^ q , T ^ s , T ^ e , D ^ , c ^ ) , F_{\theta}(x)=\bigl(\hat{T}_{q},\hat{T}_{s},\hat{T}_{e},\hat{D},\hat{c}\bigr), (3) namely the quality, scene, and event tag sets, a set of labeled boxes with confidences, and a caption.

blocks.en: A LoRA [ 17 ] with rank 16 is applied to eligible linear layers. For a frozen weight W 0 W_{0} and input z z , it adds a trainable update h = ( W 0 + α r ​ U ​ V ) ​ z h=(W_{0}+\tfrac{\alpha}{r}UV)z , and all tasks jointly update this adapter. Task A uses a concise instruction requesting a compact JSON array for one namespace; Task B uses the pretrained <OD> token and represents each object as its text label followed by four location tokens on a 1,000-bin grid; Task C uses <CAPTION> . Each response is generated autoregressively as p θ ​ ( y ∣ x , p t ) = ∏ j p θ ​ ( y j ∣ x , p t , y < j ) p_{\theta}(y\mid x,p_{t})=\prod_{j}p_{\theta}(y_{j}\mid x,p_{t},y_{<j}) , so category names and coordinates are predicted in the same sequence. For export, non-tied LoRA matrices are fused into the dense model, while the small update to the output head, whose weights are tied to the input embeddings, is kept as a residual. The exported model has 232.25M parameters.
blocks.zh: 具有16级的LORA[17]适用于合格的线性地层。 对于被冻结的重量W 0 W_{0}并输入 z z,它添加了可列车更新 h = (W 0 + α r U V ) z h = (W_{0}+\tfrac\ alpha}{r}UV)z,所有任务共同更新这个适配器. 任务 A使用简洁指令请求一个命名空间的紧凑的JSON阵列; 任务 B使用预先训练的"OD"符号并代表每个对象作为文本标签,然后在1000-bin网格上显示四个位置符号; 任务 C使用"CAPTION". 每个响应都自动生成为p θ (y ∣ x, p t) = ∏ j θ (y j ∣ x, p t, y < j)  p (y\ mid x, p_{t}) =\ prod_{j}p_{\theta} (y_{j}\ mid mid x,p_{t}, y_{<j}),所以分类名称和坐标以相同的顺序预测. 对于导出,非齿质的LORA矩阵被熔接到稠密的模型中,而小更新到输出头,其重量被捆绑在输入嵌入上,则被保留为残基. 出口型号有232.25M参数.

blocks.en: Quality, scene, and event concepts come from different datasets, so label coverage depends on how sources are combined. The training mixture draws on five sources: KonIQ-10k [ 16 ] images with deterministic distortion recipes for categorical quality labels, Places365 [ 31 ] annotations mapped to the 35 scene labels, NUS-WIDE [ 5 ] user tags matched to the event vocabulary as weak labels, LVIS v1 [ 14 ] for detection, and Flickr30k [ 30 ] for captions. The mixture is expanded from 10K to 30K examples, comprising 9,000 tagging, 10,500 detection, and 10,500 caption examples. Because a source image rarely annotates every field of Eq. ( 3 ), observed namespaces are represented by a supervision mask: an unannotated namespace is treated as unlabeled, not as a negative. Task sampling cycles each task to the size of the largest group, giving equal presentations of tagging, detection, and captioning in each effective epoch. On the official leaderboard, the 30K mixture raises the final score from 15.89 to 16.72, with the gain coming from tagging.
blocks.zh: 质量,场景,和事件的概念来自不同的数据集,因此标签覆盖度取决于来源是如何组合的. 培训混合物利用了五个来源:KONIQ-10k [16] 带有绝对质量标签定型扭曲配方的图像、35个场景标签的Place365 [31] 说明、NUS-WIDE [5] 用户标签与事件词汇对应为弱标签、LVIS v1 [14] 用于检测、Flickr30k [30] 用于标题。 混合物的例子从10K扩大到30K,包括9 000个标记、10 500个检测和10 500个标题例子。 由于源图像很少对Eq. (3)的每个字段进行注释,所观测到的命名空间都用监督口罩来表示:未附加说明的命名空间被作为无标签处理,而不是作为负. 任务取样周期每个任务到最大组的大小,在每个有效时段对标记、检测和标题进行同样的介绍。 在正式的领跑板上,30K混合物将最终得分从15.89分提升到16.72分,收益来自标记.

blocks.en: CapMap-MS-TTA is a training-free solution built on Florence-2-base [ 28 ] , with 231.41M parameters and about 0.6 GB of peak memory at batch size 1. All tasks share the same weights θ \theta without fine-tuning. Florence-2 casts each task as conditional sequence generation, o = Decode ⁡ ( f θ ​ ( I , τ ) ) o=\operatorname{Decode}(f_{\theta}(I,\tau)) , where τ \tau is a task token. As shown in Fig. 3 , Tasks A and C share a single detailed-caption pathway, while Task B uses multi-view detection with test-time augmentation (TTA) followed by non-maximum suppression (NMS). The improvements come from prompt routing, deterministic post-processing, and detection TTA.

blocks.en: Tags are derived from the same detailed caption. A phrase-to-tag dictionary ℳ \mathcal{M} maps phrases to labels of the closed vocabulary 𝒱 = 𝒱 q ∪ 𝒱 s ∪ 𝒱 e \mathcal{V}=\mathcal{V}_{q}\cup\mathcal{V}_{s}\cup\mathcal{V}_{e} , for example “shopping mall” to shopping_mall . With y ~ \tilde{y} the lower-cased caption, Map ( y ; ℳ ) = { ℳ ( p ) | p ∈ dom ( ℳ ) , p occurs in y ~ as a whole phrase } . \mathrm{Map}(y;\mathcal{M})=\bigl\{\mathcal{M}(p)\;\big|\;p\in\mathrm{dom}(\mathcal{M}),\ p\text{ occurs in }\tilde{y}\text{ as a whole phrase}\bigr\}. (7) Whole-phrase matching avoids substring errors such as ski in “skin” or mall in “small”, which otherwise produce many false scene tags. Quality tags additionally use image statistics: with G G the grayscale image and Δ \Delta a discrete Laplacian, the variance v = Var ⁡ ( Δ ​ G ) v=\mathrm{Var}(\Delta G) and mean intensity μ = Mean ⁡ ( G ) \mu=\mathrm{Mean}(G) yield heuristic tags Q ⁡ ( v , μ ) ⊆ 𝒱 q Q(v,\mu)\subseteq\mathcal{V}_{q} for blur, low light, and under- or overexposure. Starting from a base tag set T 0 T_{0} , the expand-hints stage only adds tags, T = T 0 ∪ Map ⁡ ( y , ℳ ) ∪ Q ⁡ ( v , μ ) T=T_{0}\cup\mathrm{Map}(y;\mathcal{M})\cup Q(v,\mu) , so it never reduces recall. A final cleanup removes outdoor when both indoor and outdoor are present, and otherwise adds indoor or outdoor when the scene tags contain an indoor- or outdoor-indicative category.

blocks.en: Florence-2 open detection ( <OD> ) is run on rescaled and horizontally flipped views. Let 𝒮 = { 0.75 , 1.0 , 1.25 } \mathcal{S}=\{0.75,1.0,1.25\} , let H \mathrm{H} denote horizontal flipping, and let Φ s \Phi_{s} map boxes from the image I s I_{s} at scale s s back to the original resolution. Flipped boxes are reflected as H − 1 ​ ( b ) = ( W − x 2 , y 1 , W − x 1 , y 2 ) \mathrm{H}^{-1}(b)=(W-x_{2},y_{1},W-x_{1},y_{2}) before rescaling, and the proposal pool is 𝒫 = ⋃ s ∈ 𝒮 ( Φ s ​ ( OD ⁡ ( I s ) ) ∪ Φ s ​ ( H − 1 ​ ( OD ⁡ ( H ⁡ ( I s ) ) ) ) ) . \mathcal{P}=\bigcup_{s\in\mathcal{S}}\Bigl(\Phi_{s}\bigl(\mathrm{OD}(I_{s})\bigr)\cup\Phi_{s}\bigl(\mathrm{H}^{-1}(\mathrm{OD}(\mathrm{H}(I_{s})))\bigr)\Bigr). (8) Smaller scales recover objects missed at native resolution, larger scales help in crowded scenes, and flipping adds complementary proposals for asymmetric objects. Label-aware NMS keeps a box unless a kept box with the same label overlaps it with IoU above 0.5, retaining at most 300 boxes, and malformed labels are discarded for schema validity. Because Florence-2 detection often returns no scores, boxes receive a constant confidence of 0.85, so the gain comes from geometric redundancy and NMS instead of score thresholding. Relative to the Florence-2-base baseline, expand-hints raises the tagging score from 21.15 to 26.49 and TTA raises the detection score from 4.77 to 5.45, while the caption score is unchanged.

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion and Discussion
blocks.zh: 4. 结论和讨论

blocks.en: All three leading solutions build on Florence-2-base, whose prompt-based sequence interface covers detection and captioning with one set of weights while leaving ample headroom under the 0.5B-parameter limit. They differ mainly in how they add multi-concept tagging, which Florence-2 does not support natively: SSUfficient trains lightweight heads on frozen shared features, Team Spicy Gradient Descent fine-tunes a shared LoRA to generate tag lists as text, and DDUN maps detailed captions to the closed vocabulary without training. Fine-tuning the shared model on coverage-aware tag supervision yields by far the highest tagging score but lowers caption quality, whereas the entries that keep the pretrained captioning pathway intact obtain the highest caption scores, which carry substantial weight in the final score.
blocks.zh: 所有三种领先的解决方案都以Florence-2-base为基础,其即时序列界面覆盖了检测和字幕,并配有一组重量,同时在0.5B参数限制下留下了充足的头室. 他们主要在加入多概念标记的方式上有所不同,佛罗伦萨-2并不在本土上支持:SSUfficient trains轻量级头部在被冻结的共享特性上,Team Spicy Gradient Engein对一个共享的LORA进行微调以生成标签列表作为文本,DDUN地图对封闭词汇的详细标题没有培训. 精细调整覆盖-意识标签监督共享模式的分数迄今是最高的标记分数,但降低了标题质量,而保留预先训练的标记分数的条目则完好无损地获得最高的标记分数,在最终分数中具有相当大的分量。

blocks.en: A second recurring theme is that the tasks inform one another at inference time. Captions supply object names for open-vocabulary detection and phrase grounding, detections refine captions, and captions, detections, and image statistics refine quality, scene, and event tags. Teams also tune decoding and post-processing separately for each task, since beam widths, generation caps, and NMS thresholds that help one output can hurt another. Multi-scale and flip augmentation further increases detection recall without adding parameters.
blocks.zh: 第二个反复出现的主题是任务在推论时相互通报. Captions 提供用于开口站站点检测和词组搁浅的物体名称,检测精炼了标题,以及标题,检测和图像统计精炼了质量,场景和事件标记. 团队还为每项任务分别调谐解码和后处理,因为梁宽,生成盖,以及帮助一个输出的NMS阈值会伤害到另一个. 多尺度和翻转增强进一步增加了检测回放而未添加参数.

blocks.en: Open-vocabulary detection on hidden novel categories remains the main bottleneck, with the best novel-aware mAP of only 8.22. The second- and third-place teams note that sequence-based detection in Florence-2 lacks calibrated per-box confidences and must decide through a single end-of-sequence token how many objects to emit, while the 30-token caption budget forces aggressive truncation of detailed captions. Future work could jointly train compact unified models across all three tasks under the resource budget, estimate region-level confidences within the shared decoder, and measure latency and memory on actual mobile hardware.
blocks.zh: 在隐藏的小说类别上进行公开-vocabulary探测仍然是主要的瓶颈,最有小说意识的MAP只有8.22. 第二名和第三名的队伍指出,佛罗伦萨-2的以序列为主的检测缺乏每盒置信度的校正,必须通过一个单一的后序符来决定要发射的物体数量,而由30个子的字幕预算则迫使详细字幕的截取十分激烈. 今后的工作可以联合培训所有三项资源预算下的紧凑统一模式,估计共享解码器内的区域一级信心,并衡量实际移动硬件的延迟性和内存。
